facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports Congo is among 16 countries Starlink marks 'Starting in 2026' on its map, shown in the colour for pending regulatory authorisation, and that service was still not available in Congo despite a 2025 forecast.

note: Table lists Republic of Congo only as estimated availability 2026, not Available; no licence status stated.
Congo-Brazzaville only listed as scheduled for 2026; no licence status stated.

facts.fact: Le360 lists Congo-Brazzaville as 'available from 2026' with no licence granted to Starlink as of May 2026.
ARPCE seized an unauthorised Starlink installation in Congo-Brazzaville in June 2024.

note: ARPCE seminar closing report names OneWeb and Starlink only as emerging technologies to regulate; no licence, sale or ban stated.
ARPCE training mission in France on LEO regulation, met Eutelsat; no licence, sale or ban stated for COG.

facts.fact: ARPCE says Starlink has not obtained the authorisation required to operate in Congo, and seized an unauthorised Starlink kit at a logging site on 28 May 2024.
